name: agsva-security-clearance-platform
description: Local-first AGSVA security clearance readiness platform and validation server.

scripts.check:server: npm run build:firebase-config && node --experimental-sqlite --check server/local-app.mjs && node --check app-runtime.js && node --check firebase-config.js && node --check server/persistence.mjs && node --check scripts/sync-firebase-config.mjs
scripts.check:shell: bash -n scripts/check-repo-hygiene.sh && bash -n scripts/serve-draft.sh && bash -n scripts/serve-index.sh && bash -n scripts/test-local-app.sh
scripts.ci: npm run check:repo && npm run check:server && npm run check:shell && npm run test:smoke
